info.title: API.SH: 99acres
info.description: The 99acres API from API.SH: public 99acres data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One property on 99acres with everything the page shows: id, link, title, purpose, type, price, price per sq ft, negotiable flag, booking amount, maintenance, bedrooms, bathrooms, balconies, extra rooms, super built-up / built-up / carpet area, floor and floors, furnishing with item counts, facing, flooring, overlooking, water source, power backup, parking, gated community, corner and pet-friendly flags, age, availability, transaction, ownership, internal and external features, highlights, society, address, locality, city, coordinates, description, nearby places with distances, the advertiser (type, name, company, member since, website, profile), dates, photos, video, the locality's rating by feature and a link to the locality overview (`locality_url`). Give the 99acres.com link as `url`, or `latest=true` with search params to open the first current result.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/99acres-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A 99acres.com property link ending in `-spid-...` (`url` of a search result).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current property.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With latest=true: the search city (other search params work too).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/99acres-locality

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
